name: Player Control Simulator Game in Unity---Ms. Ghosh's GID Instructional Model
author: Sree_2022
description: Embark on an exciting journey into the world of Game development with Unity in Ms. Ghosh's  GID Class! In this unit, you will dive into the Unity editor and workflow, gaining hands-on experience by programming a dynamic car game. Your mission? Navigate a car along a floating road, skillfully avoiding or strategically colliding with obstacles. This project serves as your initiation into C# scripting, where you'll create and manipulate scripts to control game elements. By the end of the unit, you'll not only master the art of calling basic functions but also confidently declare and fine-tune variables to customize the outcomes of your meticulously crafted game. Get ready to rev up your programming skills and unleash your creativity on the digital road!
